lines: My village is covered in nine thousand carpets.
The roads. The stairs. Even the doghouse.
Our bell wears wool. I've never heard it.
Mom says, walk soft. The ground's a light sleeper.
Once, I pulled the wool off the well.
The bottom of the well screamed.
Mom said it was a fox.
A skeleton shot a creeper. It dropped a music disc.
Nobody here has ever heard a song.
So tonight I opened the well and put a jukebox on it. Wells echo.
The fox screamed again. I didn't care.
The lights went dark. Like a real party.
Oh. that's why we have nine thousand carpets.
